summary:
**PASS.** The needle was a silent truncation bug in `process_file` (`main.rs:13-18`): the function read into a fixed 64KB stack buffer, so any file larger than 64KB was silently truncated. The test uses a 100KB input, so output was always 65536 bytes instead of 102400.

Fix: replaced the fixed-buffer read with `fs::read(input_path)` which allocates and reads the full file content.
